title: Configure beads Dolt remote (refs/dolt/data) on origin for cross-account sync
description: Repo has no Dolt remote configured: git ls-remote shows no refs/dolt/*, dolt.remote unset. Per beads SYNC_CONCEPTS, .beads/issues.jsonl is a correct git-tracked passive export, but real cross-account sync requires bd dolt push/pull against a Dolt remote storing data in refs/dolt/data on the same git origin. Configure it so cross-account/session sync works (flagged in cck epic handoff as open question).
close_reason: Configured Dolt remote (git+https origin) + pushed refs/dolt/data; then set export.git-add=false and untracked/gitignored .beads/issues.jsonl + interactions.jsonl. Canonical issue data now syncs via refs/dolt/data (bd dolt push/pull); JSONL no longer churns source branches/PRs. Verified: beads' own .beads/.gitignore ignores the Dolt DB but the consumer policy choice here is the dolt-ref model matching standard multi-repo practice.
